final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT MIN(a.link_to_event) AS c1, e.status AS c2, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS c3 FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status), s2 AS (SELECT c2 AS c1, SUM(c3) AS c2 FROM s1 GROUP BY c2), s3 AS (SELECT SUM(c2) AS c1 FROM s2) SELECT s2.c1, s2.c2, CAST(s2.c2 AS REAL) / s3.c1 FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.c1 IS NOT NULL
